author: qwen3-coder-next
brief: Phase: refactor, migration and dependency upgrade. Role: developer. Repo kind: a Node.js 24 library (no dependencies) for parsing and validating shipping manifests, where one 900-line module `src/manifest.js` holds parsing, validation, pricing and rendering (plus tests, CI config and docs; about 25 files). Inspiration (idea only): public libraries organised as a package with a stable top-level API. Build a task where the owner asks to split the module into focused modules while every existing require path and export keeps working, with wrinkles of your own design (a circular require trap, module-level state that must stay one shared object, `instanceof` checks across the old and new paths, the documented public names unchanged, and no require cycle left, checked by a script the request names).
